messages:
maya: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to lock owners for the recurring cache-burst incidents. assigning proposed owners + jira links below.
kevin: thanks. can we also add acceptance criteria for each action? last time tickets landed without clear verification steps.
olivia: +1 on acceptance criteria. for the cache TTL tuning ticket, criteria = 2 weeks without >3 eviction spikes across prod clusters.
maya: noted @olivia. proposed split: (1) monitoring/alerts, (2) infra config change, (3) runbook + handoff.
raj: i can take infra config (quantized eviction thresholds). creating ticket now.
incident-bot: Created JIRA INF-5072: "cache: quantized eviction thresholds and autoscaler tuning" assigned to raj. link: https://jira.example.com/browse/INF-5072
lina: i'll own runbook + oncall play (INF-5074). will draft runbook and pair with SRE for drills.
maya: ok tickets: INF-5072 (raj), INF-5073 (kevin) monitoring dashboards, INF-5074 (lina) runbook.
kevin: INF-5073 add: add histogram of prefix lengths + token distribution, and alert when tail Q95 token processing latency > 1.2s. acceptance: dashboards + two triggered test alerts in staging.
olivia: handoff/RACI: SRE owns rollout verification; Infra implements config; Product (maya) signs off on risk/rollback plan. Mark RACI on each ticket.
maya: timeline proposals: infra changes by 2026-04-06, dashboards by 2026-04-01, runbook by 2026-04-03. are these feasible?
raj: infra ETA 04-06 ok but need 2-day freeze window for canary.
lina: runbook ETA 04-03 ok, will schedule a 30m sync with @olivia on 03-Apr to walk through play.
kevin: tagging dependent items: need a small loadtest to validate autoscaler tweaks — I'll open INF-5075 and link it.
incident-bot: Created JIRA INF-5075: "cache-burst loadtest and autoscaler validation" assigned to kevin. link: https://jira.example.com/browse/INF-5075
maya: good. admin notes: please add RACI field on each Jira, set labels: postmortem, recurring-cache-burst, p1-mitigation.
olivia: quick Q — who will verify production after infra changes? suggest @olivia + @raj pair for first 48h.
raj: agreed. i'll put a canary flag and temporary extra metrics for 72h.
lina: handing off runbook to oncall rotation once VERIFIED by SRE. we'll add acceptance step: oncall run simulated failover with runbook within 1 week of publish.
maya: final ask: confirm owners here by end of day so i can update the postmortem closure checklist and mark action owner column.
kevin: confirmed (INF-5073, INF-5075).
raj: confirmed (INF-5072).
olivia: confirmed (verification + signoff).
lina: confirmed (INF-5074).
maya: thanks everyone. i'll update the doc and close loop. :thumbsup:
kevin: one more — recommend setting recurring monthly check for eviction patterns (label: recurrence-review). I'll add to INF-5073 checklist.
maya: add it. thanks.
